name: com.zigurous.prototyping
description: A utility kit for prototyping levels in Unity with ready-to-use assets, materials, and prefabs. Materials can quickly be changed from a predefined palette of colors and patterns and are automatically tiled based on object scale. The package also provides a grid alignment system that makes blocking-out levels quick and easy.

samples.description: Unity playground scene reconstructed with the Prototyping Kit.
